calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --cli "$EVAL_W1" --worktree --task d1 --json
mu agent spawn w2 -w eval --cli "$EVAL_W2" --worktree --task d2 --json
for w in w1 w2; do git cherry-pick "$(git -C "$MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/$w" rev-parse HEAD)" || exit 1; done
for t in d1 d2; do mu task close $t -w eval --evidence "its worker reported (CLOSE block); merged"; done
for w in w1 w2; do rev=$(mu agent close $w -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -n "$rev" ] && mu agent close $w -w eval --if "$rev"; done

text: d1 and d2 are merged into main and closed; both workers are closed.
